title: ChargePoint Home Flex busybox Unnecessary Privileges Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability. (CVE-2026-131818)
description: CVE-2026-131818 is a local privilege escalation vulnerability in the busybox binary used by ChargePoint Home Flex EV chargers. The vulnerability arises because the setuid flag is set unnecessarily, allowing a local attacker who already has low-privileged code execution to escalate privileges to root. This flaw enables execution of arbitrary code with root privileges on affected devices.
